name: Terranea Resort
positioning: Oceanfront resort on 102 acres of the Palos Verdes Peninsula in Rancho Palos Verdes, just south of Los Angeles
best_for: Travelers wanting an oceanfront retreat just south of Los Angeles
Golfers who like a walkable par-3 course on ocean bluffs
Families or groups wanting casitas or villas with gourmet kitchens

facts.text: Terranea Resort sits on 102 oceanfront acres on the Palos Verdes Peninsula.
The resort is in Rancho Palos Verdes, on the Palos Verdes Peninsula just south of Los Angeles.
Guestrooms open to private balconies with views of the Pacific Ocean, Catalina Island, gardens or pools.
Each suite has a separate half-bathroom and a living room with a stocked premium bar and pantry.
The villas have expansive living spaces, a gourmet kitchen and a private garage.
The Spa at Terranea is an oceanfront spa on the Palos Verdes Peninsula.
Fitness classes range from yoga and Pilates to seaside cycling, including a signature boot camp called Nature's Gym.
The Links has a multi-tiered short-game area with chipping and putting greens.
Terranea has 135,000 square feet of ocean-view meeting and event space.
Mar'sel's name blends the Spanish and French words for sea and salt, and it puts a twist on California cuisine.
Nelson's is a casual oceanfront restaurant set among outdoor fire pits, with sunset views.

highlights.text: The Links at Terranea is a 9-hole, par-3 oceanfront golf course on the bluffs above the Pacific, and golfers walk it with the coast alongside them.
The bungalows sit near the ocean's edge, steps from the oceanfront spa.
The casitas have gourmet kitchens, great rooms and optional adjoining bedrooms for families or groups.
The Spa Pool offers lap swimming and private cabanas, with ocean views.

considerations.text: The resort is in Rancho Palos Verdes on the Palos Verdes Peninsula, south of Los Angeles rather than in the city itself.
The Spa Pool is for spa guests aged 18 and over.
WhataHotel notes the large resort property may require walking or shuttle transportation.
